<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 276.0666 likely corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral mass of ~275.059 Da. The formula C₁₁H₁₅O₈ has an exact monoisotopic mass of 275.0767 Da, which is within a few millidaltons of the calculated neutral mass and is the best fit using only C, H, and O.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H15O8</final_answer>
